newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices mixed amid EMU worries.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices mixed amid EMU worries.

text.p: Danish bond prices were mixed on Tuesday morning in a market made uneasy by greater than expected Socialist gains in the first round of the French elections and their possible implications for EMU.
At 0840 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 traded at 110.01 point, yielding 6.46 percent, slightly down from Monday's 110.10 but off an earlier Tuesday low of 109.91.
But the forthcoming benchmark seven percent state bond due 2007 rose 0.27 point, to 102.90, yielding 6.59 percent.
The yield gap between the 2006 bond and the German bund was unchanged from Monday's 53 basis points.
